AUTOMATIONS$BUG_FIXER_GITHUB_DESC: Trigger on labeled or opened issues in a GitHub repo.
AUTOMATIONS$BUG_FIXER_JIRA_DESC: Trigger on new or transitioned Jira issues via the Jira integration.
AUTOMATIONS$BUG_FIXER_REPO_PROMPT: Which repository or project should this watch? The automation is created disabled so you can review it before turning it on.
AUTOMATIONS$BUG_FIXER_CREATED_TOAST: Bug Fixer automation created — review it, then enable it.
KT$SUBTITLE: Repository understanding, generated once and available to read or watch.
KT$EMPTY: No connected repositories yet. Open a conversation with a repo attached, then come back here.
KT$NOT_FOUND: This repository hasn't been generated yet.
CODEGRAPH$EMPTY: No graph has been built for this commit yet.
CODEGRAPH$STALE: This graph was built from an older commit and may no longer match the code.
CODEGRAPH$UNKNOWN_FRESHNESS: Could not confirm whether this graph matches the current commit.
CODEGRAPH$REDUCED: Reduced analysis — some files were not parsed.
CODEGRAPH$NO_KNOWLEDGE: Generate Knowledge docs for this repository first — CodeGraph reuses them to name subsystems.
SECURITY$SUBTITLE: Understand and manage security risk across this Workspace.
SECURITY$NO_WORKSPACE: Connect a repository to scope Security to a Workspace.
SECURITY$NOT_CONFIGURED: Security scanning is not configured yet.
SECURITY$NOT_CONFIGURED_DETAIL: Nothing has been scanned, so there is nothing to report — an empty Security page means "not scanned", never "clean". Once scanning is set up, this page shows an overall risk score, findings by severity, affected components, suggested fixes, and scan history for this Workspace.
SECURITY$FIX_WITH_AGENT_DISABLED: Available once security scanning is configured
SECURITY$AREA_REPOSITORY_DETAIL: Code-level weaknesses in the repository connected to this workspace.
SECURITY$AREA_DEPENDENCIES_DETAIL: Known-vulnerable packages across the dependency graph.
SECURITY$AREA_SECRETS_DETAIL: Credentials and tokens committed to history or config.
SECURITY$AREA_MISCONFIGURATION_DETAIL: Unsafe defaults in build, runtime, and infrastructure config.
SECURITY$AREA_RISK_DETAIL: Severity, exploitability, and affected components rolled into one score.
SECURITY$AREA_REMEDIATION_DETAIL: Suggested fixes, applied changes, and verification of each.
AUTOMATIONS$PROACTIVATION_DESCRIPTION: Neo continuously looks for useful improvements in your repository.
AUTOMATIONS$PROACTIVATION_CATEGORIES: Dependencies • Tests • CI • Docs • Code Quality
AUTOMATIONS$PROACTIVATION_AUTONOMY_RECOM: Detects a problem, investigates, explains the improvement with evidence, and stops. No repository changes. Default.
AUTOMATIONS$PROACTIVATION_AUTONOMY_PREPA: Investigates, creates an isolated branch, makes the change, and runs tests. Waits for your approval before creating a pull request.
AUTOMATIONS$PROACTIVATION_AUTONOMY_CREAT: Investigates, fixes, tests, verifies, and opens a pull request automatically. Never auto-merges or deploys.
AUTOMATIONS$PROACTIVATION_WATCH_DEPENDEN: Outdated packages, safe upgrades, deprecated or unnecessary dependencies.
AUTOMATIONS$PROACTIVATION_WATCH_TEST_DES: Failing or flaky tests, obvious missing coverage, broken or outdated tests.
AUTOMATIONS$PROACTIVATION_WATCH_CI_DESC: Repeated CI failures, unstable pipelines, obvious workflow problems.
AUTOMATIONS$PROACTIVATION_WATCH_DOCUMENT: Stale docs, code/docs mismatches, undocumented components.
AUTOMATIONS$PROACTIVATION_WATCH_CODE_QUA: Duplicated logic, dead code, TODO/FIXME clusters, suspicious complexity.
AUTOMATIONS$PROACTIVATION_WATCH_REPOSITO: Outdated configuration, unused scripts, broken dev setup, easy cleanup.
AUTOMATIONS$PROACTIVATION_DISMISS_REASON: e.g. We cannot upgrade this package until the Java 21 migration.
AUTOMATIONS$PROACTIVATION_CREATE_PR_SENT: Asked the agent to open a pull request.
AUTOMATIONS$PROACTIVATION_CREATE_PR_ERRO: Could not send the create-PR request.
AUTOMATIONS$PROACTIVATION_WATCH_REQUIRED: Select at least one area to watch.
AUTOMATIONS$PROACTIVATION_NO_WORKSPACE: No active workspace — Proactivation will still let you pick repositories directly.
AGENTOPS$SUBTITLE: Live observability and governance for every agent run on this server.
AGENTOPS$COLLECTOR_DOWN_BODY: Runs, spans, budgets and the audit log are recorded by a companion process. Nothing is shown here until it is up — this page never displays sample data.
AGENTOPS$COLLECTOR_DOWN_HINT: It normally starts automatically with npm run dev.
AGENTOPS$BACKEND_UNSUPPORTED_TITLE: AgentOps needs a local agent server
AGENTOPS$BACKEND_UNSUPPORTED_BODY: The Control Tower collector reads runs directly from a local agent server. Switch to a local backend to see live runs, approvals, budgets and audit history.
AGENTOPS$EMPTY_NO_ACTIVE_RUNS: No agents are running right now.
AGENTOPS$EMPTY_START_A_TASK: No active runs. Start a task and it will appear here.
AGENTOPS$EMPTY_NO_RUN_AUDIT: No audit events for this run.
AGENTOPS$EMPTY_NO_SPANS: No spans recorded for this run yet.
AGENTOPS$EMPTY_NO_BUDGETS: No workspaces have run an agent yet. Budgets appear here once a run is recorded.
AGENTOPS$AUDIT_NO_REASONING_NOTE: Actions, tool calls, decisions and outcomes. Agent reasoning is never recorded.
AGENTOPS$BUDGET_SAVE_FAILED: Could not save the budget policy.
AGENTOPS$AUTONOMY_SUPERVISED_HINT: Confirmation mode on — the agent stops before acting.
AGENTOPS$AUTONOMY_ASSISTED_HINT: Confirmation mode on, with a higher risk threshold.
AGENTOPS$AUTONOMY_AUTONOMOUS_HINT: No confirmation prompts. Budgets still stop the run.
AGENTOPS$CONTROL_STOP_CONFIRM_BODY: "{{task}}" will be interrupted immediately. Work already written to the workspace is kept, but the agent's current turn is lost.
AGENTOPS$SPAN_SELECT_HINT: Select a span to inspect its attributes.
USAGE$UNPRICED_NOTE: Some requests used a model with no published pricing. Their tokens are counted; their cost is not estimated.
USAGE$PAGE_DESCRIPTION: Measured token, cost and memory figures. Nothing on this page is estimated beyond the cost columns, which are marked when a model has no published pricing.
AUTOMATIONS$BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE_HINT: Si acabes d'engegar la pila, el servei d'automatització encara podria estar arrencant — aquesta pàgina es connectarà automàticament tan bon punt respongui. Si no, comprova que s'estigui executant (npm run dev).
AUTOMATIONS$CREATE_SUBTITLE: Descriu què hauria de fer l'agent i quan hauria d'executar-se. Comença a executar-se segons la programació tan bon punt el crees.
AUTOMATIONS$CREATE_NAME_HELP: Com apareix aquesta automatització a la teva llista.
AUTOMATIONS$CREATE_NAME_PLACEHOLDER: Arregla la CI fallida a main
AUTOMATIONS$CREATE_INSTRUCTIONS_HELP: Què hauria de fer l'agent en cada execució. Sigues tan específic com ho series amb un company competent.
AUTOMATIONS$CREATE_INSTRUCTIONS_PLACEHOL: Comprova el repositori per veure si hi ha proves fallides a main. Troba la causa arrel, arregla-la, executa la suite de proves i obre una pull request explicant la correcció.
AUTOMATIONS$CREATE_REPOSITORY_HELP: Repositori on treballa l'agent, com a owner/repo. Deixa-ho buit per executar sense checkout.
AUTOMATIONS$CREATE_ENABLED_HELP: Desactiva-ho per crear l'automatització en pausa i revisar-la primer.
AUTOMATIONS$CREATE_INSTRUCTIONS_REQUIRED: Descriu què hauria de fer l'agent.
